title: Mahalalel
summary: Mahalalel, son of kenan, in the line of Seth (Genesis 5).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 4: Ussher, Annals: 395 AM, 3609 BC (no higher-tier year available).

birth.citation: Jones, Chronology of the Old Testament (15th ed., 2002), "Chronological Compendium", p. 1
birth.note: Jones prints only the AM figure here; no BC year is printed for this birth, so year_bc_ad is left null (not inferred).

birth.citation: Gen 5 cumulative begetting ages (father kenan begat at 70, Gen 5:12)
Ussher, Annals of the World, First Age, §16 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)
Jordan, "The Chronology of the Pentateuch (Part 2)," Biblical Chronology 6:4 (April 1994), §4 "The Chronology of Genesis 4 & 5" (year list)
birth.note: Printed as 396 on both biblicalhorizons.com and garynorth.com. Straight MT arithmetic gives 395 (Kenan 325 + 70) and Jordan's own next line has Jared born 460 (= 395 + 65), so 396 is probably a misprint; recorded as printed, not corrected.

birth.date: 395 AM (birth year printed at the start of the mahalalel bar)
birth.citation: Anno Mundi Chronology Studies (unnamed compiler; a compilation of James B. Jordan's system), p. 1, chart "A.M. Chronology (Anno Mundi “Year of the World”) Genesis 5, 11:10"
birth.note: Matches the Masoretic arithmetic (Kenan 70 + 325); Jordan's own list prints 396. Differs from Jordan's own published figure(s): AM 396.

birth.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 781b
birth.note: Year cell "1078 396". To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 895 at the end of the name is the lifespan he prints. His table also prints the death at World 1290. 396 + 895 is not 1290. Both figures are left as printed.

death.note: Not stated in the Jones sources read (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament 15th ed. 2002, Chronological Compendium p. 1). Leave empty until verified.

death.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, First Age, §27 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)
Jordan, "The Chronology of the Pentateuch (Part 2)," Biblical Chronology 6:4 (April 1994), §4 "The Chronology of Genesis 4 & 5" (year list)
death.note: Also BC 6:10: "he died in the year a.m.1290, which is 366 years before the Flood."

death.citation: Anno Mundi Chronology Studies (unnamed compiler; a compilation of James B. Jordan's system), p. 1, chart "A.M. Chronology (Anno Mundi “Year of the World”) Genesis 5, 11:10"
death.note: Agrees with Jordan's own published AM 1290.

death.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 782a
death.note: Year cell "1972 1290". To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682.
